# dsh-voice-dialog
Continuous voice conversation for DeepSeek Harness: one microphone in the composer, read-aloud while
voice input is active, model-controlled voice intents, and soft interruptions that are handed to th
e running model instead of hard-cancelling it.
## What it does
- **One microphone, no mode button.** The composer microphone starts and stops continuous listening.
There is no floating panel and no second toolbar control. While listening, the left close button st
ops listening but lets the current read-aloud finish; the square hang-up button also interrupts play

back and cancels sentences still being synthesized on the host.
- **Continuous dictation.** A small
VAD closes an utterance after ~1.4 s of silence and transcribes it through DSH speech-to-text. With
simultaneous-speech separation enabled, the endpoint is tracked per separated source: your lane clos
es after its own 1.6 s of silence even while someone next to you keeps talking. Speech from the enro
lled owner is sent with `session.prompt(..., "queue")` by default, so it waits for the current reply
; a setting switches it to `steer` for immediate barge-in. Other speakers are queued by default. Up
to three utterances are transcribed in parallel; recognition is parallel, while delivery is one stri
ct FIFO queue in speaking order. The microphone opening threshold is adjustable, so quiet speech can

trigger sooner while a noisy room can be made less sensitive.
- **Read-aloud while listening.** The
host taps `llm/stream`, segments assistant text into sentences, synthesizes Edge TTS audio, and str
eams it over SSE. A long first sentence starts at its first natural comma once it has enough words,
so the first audio does not wait for the final full stop. Playback is gated by the microphone: start
ing the mic enables it, stopping the mic stops accepting new sentences but drains the audio already

queued. If Edge is unreachable, sentences use the platform speech voice instead of disappearing.
- *
*Priority barge-in.** When you start speaking, the reply is ducked (not stopped). Owner speech is qu
eued with `session.prompt(..., "queue")` by default, so the reply you are listening to is not cut of
f; the setting can switch it to `steer`. Guest speech enters the same FIFO queue in speaking order,
so a nearby interjection does not derail the current answer; guests can also be made to steer immedi

ately or be ignored.
[该节后续省略]
## Requirements

- DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` or a compatible build.
- Node.js 22+ (DSH requirement).
- A working DSH speech-to

-text provider. This bundle composes the host rows itself:
`speech-to-text`, `speech-to-text-sensevo

ice`, `api-speech-to-text`.
- Network access to Microsoft Edge TTS for the selected voice; without i
t, read-aloud falls back to the browser's system voice. The first SenseVoice use may need a model do
wnload. When Edge needs a proxy, the plugin reads `HTTPS_PROXY` / `HTTP_PROXY` and tunnels the WebSo

cket with CONNECT; `DSH_VOICE_TTS_PROXY` overrides it and `NO_PROXY` can exempt Edge.
- A secure bro

wser context for the microphone: `https://` or `http://localhost` / `http://127.0.0.1`.
- Optional s
peaker labels: `sherpa-onnx-node` (installed as an optional dependency; it resolves a prebuilt nativ
e addon for this platform) and a one-time ~27 MB CAM++ model download. Without them, voice input sti

ll works, just without speaker labels.
- Optional simultaneous-speech separation: `onnxruntime-node`
plus a one-time ~234 MB MossFormer2 model download (an ONNX export of Alibaba's `MossFormer2_SS_16K
`, Apache-2.0). DirectML is tried first (about 0.4 s per 4 s window on a supported GPU); CPU is the
fallback. Without it, ordinary dictation is unchanged.

### Important: disable the built-in voice-input bundle

This plugin owns the same three speech host rows as
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundl

e`. Do **not** enable both in one
profile; they would register the same services twice. Remove the b

uilt-in bundle
from `dsh.profile.bundles` (or disable it in the Plugins page) before enabling
`dsh-v
oice-dialog`. The microphone UI is replaced by this plugin, so nothing is lost.
## Use

1. Open a conversation and click the microphone in the composer.
2. Speak normally. Pauses close an

utterance and insert it into the running turn.
3. Assistant replies are read aloud automatically whi

le the microphone is listening.
[该节后续省略]
## Architecture
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- The host never reads reasoning, tool arguments, compaction summaries or session titles.
- A reply
is **not** cancelled on barge-in by default. Only playback gain is ducked. Owner and guest speech sh
are one FIFO queue in speaking order, so a faster ASR result cannot overtake an earlier utterance. A
versioned organizer plan may mark the new owner entry as `steer` and fade the current sentence; an

explicit “打断” command still cancels the organizer, stops playback and clears the unsent queue.
- The
generated speech Remote contribution is vendored in `src/speech-remote.js`, so the client does not
need the built-in voice-input UI module to mount it.
## Privacy
- Audio is transcribed by the configured DSH provider. With the default SenseVoice provider it stays

on this machine.
- Only the final sentence text is sent to Microsoft Edge TTS for read-aloud.
- The
parallel organizer sends the current transcript plus playing/queued flags to the configured DSH pro

vider; it never receives the full conversation history.
- Speaker verification and simultaneous-spee
ch separation run on the local host. The browser sends the short segment to `127.0.0.1`; the host st
ores only the 192-dimensional embedding (no audio) and never sends it to a cloud service. Separated
streams exist only in memory for the current request. Other speakers are clustered in memory for the

current session and are not persisted.
- Browser preferences stay in `localStorage`; the voice id i
s stored under `~/.dsh/voice-dialog/settings.json`. No API keys are used.
